ReportingDateTime.name: Reporting Date Time
ReportingDateTime.definition: Indicates the reporting date and full hour that transaction was reported.

ExecutionDateTime.name: Execution Date Time
ExecutionDateTime.definition: Indicates the date and full hour the trade was executed.

MaturityDate.name: Maturity Date
MaturityDate.definition: Indicates the date when the trade was matured.

EffectiveDate.name: Effective Date
EffectiveDate.definition: Indicates the date when obligations under the contract come into effect.

ValuationDateTime.name: Valuation Date Time
ValuationDateTime.definition: Date and time of the valuation.

ExpirationDate.name: Expiration Date
ExpirationDate.definition: Indicates the date when the trade was terminated.

EarlyTerminationDate.name: Early Termination Date
EarlyTerminationDate.definition: Indicates the effective date of the early termination of the reported derivative transaction.

CollateralTimeStamp.name: Collateral Time Stamp
CollateralTimeStamp.definition: Indicates the collateral time stamp range.

HistoricalAsOfDate.name: Historical As Of Date
HistoricalAsOfDate.definition: Indicates a historical as-of date for which the query response shall be prepared.

OneElementPresentRule.definition: At least one element must be present.
